text:
Priya (People Ops): quick thread — need comp‑band exception + benefits acceleration for Marco Diaz (candidate). Offer approved by hiring mgr but visa/relocate timeline is tight (candidate requesting 2026-04-04 start). Requesting provisional uplift and split sign‑on. Can we confirm routing? packet: https://redwood-internal/hr/offers/marco-diaz
Sam (Hiring Manager): +1 from me. Marco's background justifies moving to L7. We need this wrapped this week.
Jordan (Recruiter): candidate accepted verbally pending final offer. If benefits can't start on 4/4 they'll want a bridging stipend.
Leah (Finance): need the comp math and GL code. What's total cash comp, how much uplift, and sign-on schedule?
Priya (People Ops): putting numbers here:
```
Current offer (L6): Base $200,000
Proposed (L7 provisional): Base $230,000
Sign-on requested: $30,000 (split 50/50; 50% at start, 50% at 6 months)
Relocation: $10,000 lump
Benefits eligibility requested: 2026-04-04 (immediate)
Rationale: candidate has prior leadership + unique infra experience; retention risk if start delayed
```
Leah (Finance): ok math looks clear. Uplift delta $30k base -> exec approval required for >$20k base move. Also need budget owner sign-off and GL code.
Maya (Comp Committee): can you attach a short justification doc and manager statement? committee needs 1–2 bullets on business impact + comparable comp data.
Priya (People Ops): uploaded: https://redwood-internal/docs/comp-justifications/marco-2026.pdf — bullets: (1) immediate ownership of latency project, (2) expected 3x throughput improvement, (3) risk of losing to competitor.
Nadia (VP Eng): I can approve provisional uplift for 90 days contingent on performance and standard clawback. Approve conditionally: sign-on split as proposed, final base confirms after 90d review.
Leah (Finance): with Nadia's note we can provision budget, but we need Legal language for visa salary guarantee and clawback. @Legal can you advise?
Legal (Legal): recommend adding clause: "In the event of voluntary departure or termination for cause within 12 months, sign-on prorated repayment applies." Also advise on visa wage guarantee wording — uploading template.
hr-bot: attached template: /templates/visa-salary-guarantee-v1.docx
Jordan (Recruiter): noted — I'll include the clause in offer letter draft. Candidate ok with 50/50 sign-on split.
Priya (People Ops): routing summary I'm going to kick off now: comp‑committee (formal review), finance approval (budget/GL), legal for clause sign-off, and Nadia final exec approval recorded. I'll route via comp-committee@redwood.com and finance-approvals.
Maya (Comp Committee): we'll review today; if docs are complete I can fast-track.
Leah (Finance): please include proposed GL: 6101.1200 and budget owner: eng-platform. Once we have that, I'll mark approved pending legal doc.
Priya (People Ops): added GL and owner to packet. Filing route: comp-committee -> finance -> legal -> Nadia final signoff. Target finish: today EOD.
Sam (Hiring Manager): thanks — appreciate the hustle. Marco's excited.
Priya (People Ops): will update thread as approvals come in. tagging @Jordan to follow up on offer send and candidate confirmation. :thumbsup:
Maya (Comp Committee): approved (fast-track) — added note in comp form.
Leah (Finance): approved (pending legal text).
Legal (Legal): signed off on visa clause and clawback language.
Priya (People Ops): final: Nadia confirmed in DM, finance & legal approved in thread. Offer to be sent at 16:30 PT. Closing thread after offer accepted. :party_parrot:
